ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (2025 Revision, effective 1 January 2025); Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information, jointly issued by the People's Bank of China and the State Administration for Market Regulation as PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3, effective 1 November 2024; Measures for Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Supervision and Administration of Financial Institutions (PBOC Order No. 1 [2021]); Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision) and the Administrative Provisions on Market Entity Registration

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the Foreign Direct Investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or commercial registry of the jurisdiction in which the foreign direct investor is incorporated
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: If the issuing state is a Hague Apostille Convention Contracting Party, issue and attach a conventional Apostille Certificate from that state's designated competent authority only; consular legalization must not be added. If the issuing state is not an Apostille Convention Contracting Party, use consular legalization exclusively through the PRC Embassy or Consulate having jurisdiction, after the required local notarization and foreign ministry authentication; the two authentication paths are parallel, mutually exclusive, and never chained sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of the Foreign Direct Investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or other competent authority of the foreign direct investor's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the competent authority of the Apostille Contracting State if applicable; otherwise sole-route consular legalization at the competent PRC Embassy/Consulate for non-member states; no sequential combination of apostille and consular legalization is permitted under PRC practice.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney authorizing the incorporation of the WFOE and the filing of bank and tax documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the foreign direct investor or authorized notary public in the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Authentication by means of a Hague Apostille Certificate where the shareholder's jurisdiction is a Contracting Party; alternatively, for non-Contracting Party jurisdictions, consular legalization by the PRC Embassy/Consulate alone. The two methods are mutually exclusive alternatives and cannot be layered sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association or Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Foreign Direct Investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registrar, corporate secretary, or notary public of the foreign direct investor's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille route: certificate issued by the Apostille competent authority of the issuing state, with no consular legalization. Consular route: for non-member states only, notarize and authenticate locally, then legalize solely through the Chinese Embassy/Consulate with jurisdiction; apostille may never be followed by consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the Foreign Direct Investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Relationship bank of the foreign direct investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank officer certification, then Hague Apostille by the issuing state's competent authority if that state belongs to the Apostille Convention; otherwise consular legalization via the PRC Embassy/Consulate covering the bank's state. No chain of apostille and consular legalization may be used.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: The foreign direct investor, every ultimate beneficial owner, each director, each legal representative, and all senior managers and authorized signatories must be screened without exception against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, OFAC sectoral and other non-SDN sanctions lists, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the domestic sanctions and terrorist financing lists maintained by the Ministry of Public Security and the People's Bank of China. Any positive PEP match, including foreign PEPs under FATF Recommendation 12, requires documented source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification, senior management approval, enhanced ongoing monitoring, and a file memo before any WFOE formation step proceeds. Screening results must be refreshed continuously and immediately before execution of formation documents, with adverse media and corporate integrity checks forming part of enhanced due diligence.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) Enterprise Name Self-Declaration and Reservation System operated through the SAMR national enterprise name portal and local Administration for Market Regulation online platforms
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered statutory name of a China Mainland WFOE must be composed in simplified Chinese characters; the English name is not a substitute for the registered Chinese name. The mandatory four-tier naming formula is: administrative division plus distinctive trade name plus industry or business-characteristic segment plus legal form suffix, with the legal form suffix being limited company. The foreign investor's name may be rendered through Chinese phonetic transliteration, but the Chinese name may not contain Latin script, Arabic numerals, symbols, or a collocation that creates public confusion. The industry segment must accurately describe lithium iron phosphate battery pack assembly and energy-storage manufacturing, and any trade name segment importing State, public, financial, military, or misleading connotations is prohibited unless ministerial approval is obtained.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon written rejection of the name declaration, the applicant through local counsel may file an administrative reconsideration with the market regulation administration at the next higher level within 60 days of receipt of the rejection notice, or alternatively bring an administrative lawsuit before the competent people's court within six months. The appeal submission must include the name declaration receipt number, the official rejection reasons, a legal memorandum showing compliance with the four-tier name formula, evidence of no identical or confusingly similar prior registered name, a demonstration that no prohibited or sensitive token is present, and the foreign investor's signed power of attorney. The reviewing SAMR body must issue a reasoned written decision; an adverse decision may itself be appealed within the statutory time limits.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office or commercial mailbox arrangements are not permissible for this industry in China Mainland. The WFOE must maintain a physical registered office matching the business license, tax registration, and bank KYC records, and the registered address must be capable of actual operational use. For an LFP lithium battery pack assembly company, the tax authorities, SAMR, banks, fire authorities, and environmental regulators all expect to find a real business location with production, storage, or other documented substance. A commercial postal-only address will be rejected by the local tax bureau and by banks for opening corporate accounts, and will trigger denial or revocation of registration and an AML/CFT risk escalation.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist: verify the registered address against the lease agreement and property ownership certificate; retain the original lease and receipt of rent; display the statutory business license plaque at the registered premises; maintain evidence that the premises contains office, warehousing, or manufacturing operations consistent with battery pack assembly; and ensure the address matches tax registration, VAT filing, corporate income tax filings, bank account opening files, and customs or export filings. Quantified risk of an unannounced or short-notice physical inspection by municipal tax or SAMR authorities is high, estimated at 75 percent to 90 percent likelihood within the first 12 months of operation, due to the energy-storage manufacturing classification, the requirement for fire and environmental safety permits, and the random inspection quotas imposed on SAMR and tax bureaus.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No official registration fee is charged in China Mainland; statutory zero-tariff item

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory no-fee tax enrollment; external counsel coordination at hourly rate if required

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Qualified translation company or notarized translation service

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (as amended and effective 1 July 2024), particularly Articles 22, 24, 27, 28, 34, 36, 42, 43, 47, 48, 49, 51, 59, 66, 83, 84, 85 and 86 of Company Law; Foreign Investment Law of the PRC (2019) and its Implementing Regulations; the Regulations of the People's Republic of China on Registration of Companies; and the Measures on the Registration of Market Entities under SAMR.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), with the actual registration processed by the local Municipal or District Administration for Market Regulation in the city where the WFOE is domiciled; submissions may be made through the SAMR One-Window online enterprise registration portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Establishment Registration of a Foreign-Invested Limited Liability Company (SAMR Enterprise Establishment Registration Form) together with the Articles of Association and legal statements.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No national statutory minimum paid-up capital for a wholly foreign-owned LLC under the revised Company Law. Registered capital is determined by the sole shareholder and stated in the Articles of Association; it must reflect an amount commensurate with the fixed-asset investment and at least the initial three months of operating costs. Contributions may be denominated in RMB or agreed foreign currency, and the shareholder must fund the enterprise through a foreign exchange capital account established with a bank under SAFE's FDI system. There is no blocked escrow requirement at the state level; local development zones may condition incentives on staged capital deployment or an escrow guarantee.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The Shareholders of [Company Name] (the 'Company'), with [Company Name] being a wholly foreign-owned limited liability company under the Company Law of the People's Republic of China and the Foreign Investment Law, hereby adopt this First Board of Directors Resolution by unanimous written consent in accordance with Article [____] of the Articles of Association, effective as of the date stated below. Whereas the Company has obtained a unified social credit code and business license from the State Administration for Market Regulation, and whereas the subscribed share capital of RMB [Amount] has been subscribed by the sole shareholder, and whereas the Company has entered into a lease agreement for the registered office and manufacturing site, the board resolves in the following order. First, the subscription of the registered capital and the capital contribution schedule as described in the Articles of Association are ratified, and the sole shareholder is authorized to pay the subscribed capital into the Company's foreign exchange capital account. Second, the board authorizes the Chief Financial Officer and the General Manager, each acting jointly with the Chairman of the Board, to open a basic deposit account, a general deposit account and a foreign exchange capital account at licensed commercial banks, to sign bank application instruments, and to operate such accounts in accordance with the banking resolutions. Third, the registered office set out in the lease agreement is adopted as the Company's legal address and the local Market Regulation Administration shall be notified of any office relocation. Fourth, the board appoints [Name] as Chairman and legal representative, [Name] as General Manager, [Name] as Chief Financial Officer, [Name] as company supervisor, and [Name] as company secretary, each with duties applied under the Company Law and the Articles of Association. Fifth, the board directs that corporate seals including the company seal, legal representative seal, financial seal and invoice seal be legally engraved and registered with the public security authority, and that all seals be used only with the approval of the relevant director. Sixth, the board approves the internal governance rules for finance, accounting, tax and securities matters, and directs management to file the WFOE with the tax, customs and social insurance authorities within the statutory period. Seventh, all pre-incorporation contracts entered into by the sole shareholder on behalf of the Company, including the factory lease, utilities contracts and equipment purchase agreements, are hereby ratified and adopted as debts and expenses of the Company. This Resolution supersedes all preliminary resolutions and becomes effective upon adoption.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-registration enterprise name approval via the national name resolution system
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) online enterprise name registration platform, also accessible at any local Market Regulation Administrative Window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare at least three proposed Chinese company names in the format of trade name plus industry descriptor plus Company Limited, with the industry descriptor reflecting lithium battery pack manufacturing. Submit the proposed names electronically or at the window together with the intended business scope. The reviewer will check the name against the national name database for identical or confusingly similar marks. Notarized and authenticated foreign investor identity documents must be available for upload. If the name is approved, an Enterprise Name Pre-Acceptance Notice will be issued; this document is valid for six months and must be cited in the formation application.
required_dossiers: At least three proposed Chinese company names
Detailed intended business scope text in Chinese and English
Notarized certificate of incorporation or equivalent identity document of the foreign investor
Power of attorney to the formation agent
Contact and mailing address of the foreign investor
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or flagged as similar, correct the trade name descriptor or add a distinguishing element and resubmit the name application within 10 working days; an administrative reevaluation may be requested through SAMR's name dispute system.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of incorporation application and issuance of business license
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal or District Administration for Market Regulation authorized by SAMR
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the official registration form in the SAMR electronic one-window system, selecting Establishment of Foreign-Invested Company (WFOE) and attaching the Articles of Association, shareholder resolution, lease evidence, legal representative appointment and investor qualification documents. Verify that the business scope specifically includes manufacture of lithium-ion batteries and energy storage systems through battery pack assembly so that future industrial licenses are not blocked. Pay no registration fee; electronically stamp and submit. Reviews are conducted through the integrated registry and the electronic business license will be issued under the Unified Social Credit Code. Simultaneously the corporate data are automatically transmitted to taxation, statistics and social insurance systems. Retain the license and any notarized translations.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Name Pre-Acceptance Notice
Notarized and authenticated certificate of incorporation or existence of the foreign shareholder
Articles of Association signed by all shareholders
Shareholders' meeting resolution on selection of the legal representative and first directors
Office and factory lease agreement and certificate of registered address
Identity documents and consent declarations for the legal representative, supervisors and manager
Foreign investor's bank reference or solvency certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is suspended due to business scope ambiguity or address query, promptly file a supplemental explanation within 15 days; if the reviewer asks for corrected articles, amend and re-submit electronically without new registration fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engraving of corporate seals, filing registration and opening of basic bank account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Accredited seal engraving shops licensed by the Public Security Bureau and commercial banks supervised by the People's Bank of China
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After issuance of the business license, engage a public-security-licensed engraving service to make the standard corporate seals: company seal, legal representative seal, financial seal, invoice seal and contract seal. The engraved seals and the user identity are registered with the municipal Public Security Bureau seal registration system. Using the business license, unified social credit code, approved articles of association and legal representative passport, open a basic settlement account at a licensed commercial bank. The bank will transmit the basic account information to the People's Bank of China open-account registration system. The same signing authorizations approved in the first board resolution are required for the bank signature card.
required_dossiers: Business license with unified social credit code
Legal representative passport and the company articles
First board resolution authorizing bank account opening
Lease agreement for registered office and factory
Company seal, legal representative seal and financial seal for the bank specimen
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requires a physical address inspection for AML reasons, provide the landlord's ownership certificate and coordinate with the bank relationship manager; if the public security seal record is delayed, obtain a receipt from the engraving service and present a provisional use undertaking to the bank.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign exchange capital account opening and contribution of subscribed capital under SAFE rules
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial banks acting as banks designated by the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) via the Capital Project Information System
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the foreign investor's proof of eligibility and the foreign-investment articles, instruct the bank to open a foreign exchange capital account and make the filing under the FDI framework. The bank verifies the nominal amount, scope and investment project, then issues a payment confirmation certificate following the arrival of the investor's remittance. The funds must be used for business purposes, including equipment purchase for the battery pack assembly line, and cannot be used for investments outside the approved scope without a separate filing. Price checks and legal tender conversion may require submission of contracts, invoices and resolution excerpts from the board record. Maintain a ledger of all foreign capital utilization for annual FDI reporting to SAFE and the Ministry of Commerce.
required_dossiers: Business license and company seal
Notarized foreign investor identity and bank remittance instructions
First board resolution authorizing capital deposit and bank signatories
Foreign-investment confirmation or entry record issued by the local market regulator
Articles of Association and share capital schedule
Lease and equipment purchase contracts for the project
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SAFE queries the source of funds or valuation of in-kind contribution, submit the underlying notarized source documents and an independent appraisal; where contribution mode differs from the articles, obtain a shareholders' written amendment and file an amendment with SAMR before repeating the remittance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax registration, value added tax status election, customs and social insurance post-incorporation formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local office of the State Taxation Administration; China Customs for import and export; local Human Resources and Social Security Bureau; Statistics Bureau via one-stop system
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The tax registration is largely automatic from SAMR; however, the entity must separately elect VAT taxpayer status, applying for general taxpayer status if expected annual turnover exceeds 5 million RMB. Register the financial ledger system, cash register and invoicing equipment, and apply for a special VAT invoice quota; import and export permits require Customs registration through the integrated Single Window after obtaining the company's import and export code, and the foreign trade operator registration must be completed. Social insurance registration and payroll information filing is handled at the same time. Failure to complete these within 30 days may expose the WFOE to late-filing penalties; therefore the controllers should hold a compliance kickoff meeting as part of the governance records.
required_dossiers: Business license issued by SAMR
Bank account opening certificate
Company seal and CFO identity document
Lease or factory site certification
Approved Articles of Association and first board resolution
Legal representative identity documents
Planned scope of import and export of raw cells, BMS, aluminum housing components
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax authority classifies the WFOE as a small-scale VAT taxpayer by default, file the reconsideration application; for customs delays, submit an amended customs certificate and invite the local trade inspector for a site visit; any administrative query on social insurance records is cured by submission of employment contracts and a payroll system extract.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) for the lithium-ion battery industry standard conditions; the local Municipal Bureau of Industry and Information Technology for project approval and energy efficiency; State Administration for Market Regulation for product quality and compulsory certification; National Development and Reform Commission for fixed asset investment filing; and local Fire and Rescue Brigade under the Ministry of Emergency Management.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Foreign-Invested Enterprise Business License with manufacturing business scope; additionally, Fixed Investment Project Energy Conservation Review and Environmental Impact Assessment filing or permit; Fire Safety Inspection Certificate for the production facility; and product certification under the applicable catalogue (CCC) if the battery pack is used in a listed product category.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE) through the local Municipal Ecology Environment Bureau, with submission to the National Environmental Impact Assessment E-Service System
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: For LiFePO4 battery pack assembly involving only mechanical matching of modules, bus bars, welding of terminals, BMS wiring and functional testing, the usual EIA classification is an Environmental Impact Assessment Registration Form; where soldering or laser welding causes organic fumes or VOC emissions above regional thresholds, a simplified Environmental Impact Assessment Report is required. If cell electrochemistry or electrolyte is manufactured, a full EIA Report is needed. The project is not automatically exempted in restricted or sensitive areas.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater must meet the Comprehensive Wastewater Discharge Standard (GB 8978-1996), with COD not exceeding 500 mg/L, BOD5 not exceeding 300 mg/L, SS not exceeding 400 mg/L and pH 6-9, or stricter local standards where applicable. Air emissions from tin or lead soldering, laser welding and battery testing must comply with the Comprehensive Emission Standard of Air Pollutants (GB 16297-1996), including benzene at or below 12 mg/m3, toluene at or below 40 mg/m3, xylene at or below 70 mg/m3 and non-methane hydrocarbons at or below 120 mg/m3 at a 15-metre stack, or stricter municipal limits. Hazardous wastes such as used electrolyte absorbents, spent welding residue and spent batteries must be stored under the Hazardous Waste Management Regulation and contract evacuated by licensed treatment enterprises with manifests maintained; fugitive lithium dust must be controlled where operations include pack disassembly.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Must obtain the Fire Safety Inspection Certificate from the local Fire and Rescue Brigade after completion of the building fire-protection design review and pre-acceptance test; the building within the manufacturing plot must pass structural-load acceptance for the weight of battery racks and charging systems. The worksite must satisfy the Law of the People's Republic of China on Prevention and Control of Occupational Diseases, including occupational hazard evaluation, monitoring for welding fume, dust and noise, fit-for-work medical certificates and employee training, and a safety production clearance under the Work Safety Law; storage of LiFePO4 battery packs must be separated into temperature-controlled charging and tooling zones to prevent thermal runaway.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China; electronic filing through the provincial STA Electronic Tax Bureau (e-Tax) portals, supported by the national Golden Tax System Phase IV and the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) tax registration database.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a PRC WFOE, the statutory tax identification number is the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) printed on the business license. After incorporation with the Administration for Market Regulation, the registration information is transmitted to the STA through the government one-stop data exchange, completing the information-based tax registration. The WFOE must then confirm its tax registration through the local e-Tax portal within 30 days, file bank account and accounting system records, elect or confirm its VAT taxpayer status (small-scale or general taxpayer), and obtain invoice issuance entitlements. No separate TIN certificate is issued; the USCC is the single legal tax ID for Enterprise Income Tax, VAT, and other taxes. A non-resident enterprise without a permanent establishment would be addressed through withholding, but the CN_WFOE_LTD is a resident enterprise and holds direct tax registration under its USCC.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None under the Enterprise Income Tax law: a PRC WFOE is a resident enterprise and cannot make a check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch pass-through election. The only relevant statutory election is the VAT election for a small-scale taxpayer with annual taxable sales below RMB 5,000,000 to voluntarily register as a general VAT taxpayer for full input VAT credit; this is not a corporate entity classification election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT) of the People's Republic of China
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: There is no turnover threshold for basic VAT tax registration; every PRC enterprise is registered for VAT upon incorporation. Mandatory general VAT taxpayer registration is triggered when annual taxable sales reach RMB 5,000,000. Below that threshold the entity is a small-scale taxpayer, and a monthly sales exemption of RMB 100,000 (or RMB 300,000 per quarter) may apply.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China operates the National Electronic Invoice Platform and the Golden Tax System Phase IV. General VAT taxpayers issue Special VAT Invoices through the VAT Invoice Comprehensive Service Platform; each invoice carries a unique tax control number, QR code, cryptographic fiscal stamp, and is uploaded to the STA in near real time. The STA performs automated cross-checks against the USCC, invoice database, customs data, and the taxpayer's VAT returns. Input VAT on Special VAT Invoices is denied unless the supplier invoice has been matched and verified in the national invoice database. Fully digital electronic invoices are the default for most registered enterprises.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exported LiFePO4 battery packs qualify for the 0% VAT rate with input VAT refund under the PRC export tax rebate regime when the goods are actually declared to customs and physically leave PRC customs territory, the exporter is the PRC WFOE that sells to an overseas buyer, and the transaction is supported by customs export declaration, transport document, commercial invoice/contract, and foreign exchange collection. As a production enterprise, the WFOE applies the exempt-credit-refund method for exported manufactured goods. Zero-rating is not available for mere domestic bonded-zone transfers without actual export, nor for goods whose sales proceeds are not repatriated in accordance with SAFE rules.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Official Customs Declaration Form for Export Goods (Customs Export Declaration) with customs release stamp, export classification and HS code for the LiFePO4 battery pack
Marine Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export movement
Export sales contract and international commercial invoice
Packing list and, where required, lithium battery transport/certification records for dangerous goods

Bank export proceeds collection voucher issued by the settlement bank upon receipt through SWIFT LC or TT wire, which functions as the Chinese equivalent of an Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC); China does not issue a separate FIRC document
Complete VAT export rebate declaration package filed through the STA e-Tax portal, including export declaration data, VAT invoice details, and the export proceeds collection status report
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA, General Administration of Customs and SAFE jointly match export declarations, export VAT rebate filings, transport documents, and foreign exchange receipts. If the WFOE cannot substantiate zero-rating or fails to repatriate export proceeds within 180 days (or an approved statutory exception), the STA will claw back the refunded VAT with daily late-payment surcharge from the date of refund, require the export to be reclassified as a domestic taxable sale, and may impose an administrative penalty of 50% to five times the tax/refund amount involved under the Law on the Administration of Tax Collection and its Implementing Rules. Fraudulent export tax refund claims may trigger suspension or revocation of export rebate qualification, red-list credit risk consequences, and criminal liability under PRC Criminal Law for export tax refund fraud, including imprisonment and fines.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The People's Bank of China (PBoC) acting in concert with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China maintains a bifurcated convertibility regime. Current account items (goods, services, earnings) are generally convertible under the IMF Article VIII, provided there is a genuine trade background, verified documentation, and compliance with the Trade Foreign Exchange Administration Measures. Capital account items are heavily regulated: all inbound direct investment must be registered with SAFE, and opening a foreign exchange capital account requires a certified Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) registration code. Profit remittances are permitted only after annual statutory audit, full tax settlement, board resolution, and audited financial statements filed with the onshore bank, and surpluses must be evidenced by foreign currency receivable account statements. Renminbi is not freely deliverable offshore; offshore non-deliverable market (NDF) pricing persists because onshore spot and forward markets are concentric on actual trade or capital flows. Surrender of export proceeds is no longer mandatory; companies may retain foreign exchange in conventional accounts but must repatriate proceeds into China, and capital account conversions are limited to purpose-specific sales. In practice, mismatches between the capital injection schedule, business scale, and transaction pattern trigger enhanced due diligence and potential suspension of settlement.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The export settlement and verification system mandates that non-invoiced foreign exchange proceeds from physical exports be repatriated into China within 90 days from the date of customs clearance. With the 2012 SAFE reform, the mandatory surrender (cover) requirement was abolished; exporters may either retain proceeds in foreign exchange settlement accounts or convert into RMB at their FX bank, provided that the transaction is captured in the ASOne system, supported by customs declaration, invoice, bill of lading, and collection documentation. There is no mandatory conversion ratio; however, the full amount must be credited to the exporter's account in China. For advance collections, funds must be registered on the trade monitoring platform within 30 days, and discrepancies exceeding a 5% threshold trigger documentary review by the bank.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Foreign Currency Capital Escrow Account (FDI capital account)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: RMB Basic Deposit Account and Current Accounts
Foreign Exchange Settlement Account and General Operating Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Foreign digital EMI platforms (e.g., Wise, Revolut Business, Airwallex) do not possess a legal Persons License from PBoC and are therefore legally barred from providing account-held deposits, clearing, or foreign exchange settlement services to China-resident enterprises. A WFOE cannot use an offshore EMI as a primary treasury account; such platforms may only serve as a pass-through payment processor if they have a licensed onshore partner (i.e., via a licensed third-party payment institution), but funds must be held at a licensed Tier-1 commercial bank in China. Inbound capital injections and outbound trade settlements must be routed through a SAFE-registered domestic bank account. Any off-balance-sheet arrangement with an unlicensed EMI would create a compliance and money-laundering vulnerability, violate SAFE's administered-flow rules, and expose the WFOE to penalties and freezing of assets. Hence, feasibility is rated Low for primary banking and Medium only as a non-custodial payment gateway with an onshore licensed PSP.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Under PBoC No. 3/2019 and SAFE integrated Administrative Measures, statutory directors and the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) are generally required to appear physically at the bank counter in mainland China for first-time capital account opening and identity verification. Remote consular proxy opening is not permitted for a standard WFOE because the bank must verify the resident identity of the legal representative and may require a signed labor contract or local employment letter. Where travel is impossible, banks may accept a notarized power of attorney appointing a local director or senior manager to act in person, but the UBO must still pass an on-call video interview and submit a sworn source-of-funds statement. This is a strict in-person with enumerated exceptions mandate, not a pure remote process.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sector-specific dual-use concern: LiFePO4 battery packs are classified under Controlled Trade Items; the bank may suspect the WFOE will divert goods to a prohibited military or paramilitary end-user.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide (1) a pollution-free copy of the Commercial Department's Foreign Trade Operator Registration and the Export License for Dual-Use Items if applicable; (2) a signed End-User Certificate and Non-Proliferation Undertaking from the end customer; (3) technical datasheets demonstrating LFP composition is not on the defense list; (4) master supply agreement with EV OEM or grid energy-storage utility; and (5) internal trade compliance policy signed by the compliance officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital injection sourced from an offshore holding company domiciled in a known secrecy jurisdiction, indicating potential shell-company layering or illegal funds transfer.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver a demonstrable corporate chain with registered agent certificates, articles of incorporation, register of directors/shareholders, and underlying ultimate beneficial owner identification, each certified by a CPA and apostilled. Provide audited financials of the direct investor, a bank statement showing the source of the transferred funds, and a notarized Letter of Undertaking signed by the UBO confirming the absence of adverse media and sanctioned counterparties.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade flow and operational mismatch: the initial order volume for lithium battery pack assembly is several folds higher than the declared headcount, leased production space, and manufacturing equipment, creating a red flag for trade-based money laundering or invoice misrepresentation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit the signed lease contract and rent invoices, utility bills for six months, property inventory list with serial numbers, insurance policies, payroll ledger, and six-month bookkeeping records. Include a chartered accountant's asset valuation and a capacity-planning model showing production line throughput and procurement orders relative to headcount, as well as a delivery schedule through the order pipeline.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pervasive use of round-number invoices and frequent material amendment to trade contracts with suppliers in high-risk jurisdictions (e.g., over-graphic variance in unit prices for anode/cathode materials).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide tailored price-realization analysis: benchmark unit prices from independent futures/commodity quotes (e.g., LME or Shanghai Metals Market), VAT invoices, customs declaration forms, and bill of lading. Include signed contract riders explaining every amendment, internal transfer pricing documentation, and an external auditor's confirmation that the price range is within 2% of the prevailing market benchmark.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Forced FDI equity injection routing: a shareholder resident outside mainland China must wire funds from its own bank account into the WFOE's Foreign Currency Capital Settlement Account at a Tier-1 domestic bank using SWIFT MT103/MT202. The remittance must be labelled with a SAFE-recognised transaction purpose code - typically '622' for a non-resident shareholder's equity injection for establishment of a foreign-invested enterprise, and the beneficiary account name must match the FDI Registration Code. The receiving bank will require the Foreign-Invested Enterprise's Foreign Exchange Registration Certificate, a capital verification report from a Chinese CPA, and an internal account-opening file. Once funds are credited, the enterprise can use the funds for actual business expenses after converting to RMB via the Capital Account Settlement and Sale form, submitting invoices 15 working days in advance to the bank's compliance desk. Shareholder loans must be separately registered under the Foreign Debt Registration system.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade disbursements can be made via (1) SWIFT MT103 for telegraphic transfers against soft-copy invoices for low-risk open account transactions; (2) commercial documentary L/Cs issued at a Tier-1 domestic bank under UCP600 for import of lithium cathode active material, conductive agents, and battery management system panels, with documents negotiated via the beneficiary's bank; (3) documentary collections (CAD/DP) for moderate-risk relationships where the exporter forwards shipping documents through the negotiating bank with the WFOE paying upon sight. All payments must carry SAFE trade purpose codes (e.g., 1102 for imports of finished goods / raw materials under non-resident trade), and match against the customs declaration within 90 days; discrepancies beyond $10,000 per item or 5% trigger SAFE verification and possible freezing. For services such as software licenses (for battery management algorithms), use purpose code 2280 with a contract and invoice.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable CNY/USD foreign exchange forward contracts (also known as trade settlement forwards) are permissible for current account hedges; a WFOE must document a genuine trade exposure (underlying import/export contract, invoice, and customs declaration) and transact with its Tier-1 bank under the SAFE Real Demand principle, standard tenors from one week to one year, with up to 20% notional variation permitted via sourcing.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permissible onshore for a WFOE; only offshore non-resident entities may trade NDFs on CNY, and any offshore NDF must not be used to hedge an onshore entity's risk without violating SAFE's rules on deliverability and offshore-onshore linkage. Therefore, treat NDFs as off-limits for the WFOE treasury.

Cross-currency swaps (CCS) are permissible only where the WFOE has a legitimate cross-border loan or trade debt, duly registered with SAFE; the bank will allow a plain-vanilla CNY/USD swap to convert coupons and notional, but the notional cannot exceed the underlying registered external debt, and settlement must be physical rather than netted.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Information Disclosure (Annual Report filed on the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) via the local Market Supervision Administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 January to 30 June of the following calendar year for each fiscal year ended 31 December
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file by 30 June results in listing on the Operating Abnormal List, restriction on issuing tax-control invoices and inability to pass due-diligence checks; if the omission continues for three consecutive years, the company is transferred to the Serious Illegal and Untrustworthy List and the SAMR commences ex officio administrative strike-off or deregistration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Foreign Investment Information Report (reporting equity structure, investment scope and operational data of the WFOE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce of the People's Republic of China (MOFCOM), filed through the integrated SAMR annual reporting platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 January to 30 June of the following calendar year for each fiscal year ended 31 December
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-submission, late submission, or false submission exposes the WFOE to an administrative warning and a penalty of up to CNY 200,000 (approx. USD 28,000); repeated violations can lead to loss of preferential tax treatment and regulatory disqualification.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Income Tax Final Settlement (Corporate Income Tax annual return and supporting schedules)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (SAT) through the competent local tax authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 5 months after fiscal year-end, i.e., by 31 May for calendar-year taxpayers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment interest accrues at 0.05% per day on the overdue tax amount; administrative penalties range from 50% to 500% of the under-declared tax depending on the degree of fault; serious violations trigger full tax audit, inability to obtain tax clearance certificates and freezing of deregistration procedures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory Annual Financial Statement Audit by an independent licensed PRC CPA firm
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: WFOE shareholders and the Board of Shareholders; audit report retained for inspection by SAMR, MOFCOM and the SAT
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after fiscal year-end, ordinarily by 30 April, to support the annual reporting window
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to have annual financial statements audited violates Article 164 of the PRC Company Law and exposes the company to a fine of RMB 10,000 to RMB 100,000 imposed on directly liable persons; un-audited financial information also renders the annual enterprise credit report materially inaccurate and subject to SAMR penalty.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Social Insurance Contribution Base Declaration (annual wage base confirmation for Chinese employees)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Human Resources and Social Security Bureau (HRSS) and social insurance collection agency
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, generally 1 January to 30 June of the following year; exact municipal window is set by the local HRSS for the preceding year's contribution base
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or defective declaration triggers a social insurance arrears surcharge of 0.05% per day on unpaid contributions, administrative fines up to RMB 10,000, compulsory recovery against the WFOE's bank accounts, and inclusion of the entity in the social insurance credit blacklist.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: China imposes a universal statutory audit mandate rather than a balance-sheet, turnover, or headcount threshold: under Article 164 of the PRC Company Law, every PRC resident company, including every Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise, must engage an independent accounting firm to audit its annual financial statements. No asset, revenue, or employee-size exemption exists; a WFOE with zero revenue or dormant status is still required to prepare and audit annual financial statements, and an additional audit obligation arises for related-party reporting and tax basis substantiation when cross-border intercompany transactions exist.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: China Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CAS), which is materially IFRS-converged for the preparation of statutory financial statements; smaller qualifying enterprises may apply the Accounting Standards for Small Business Enterprises (ASBE) or the simplified CAS treatment, and all amounts in the statutory ledgers, financial statements, tax returns, and audited reports must be presented in Renminbi (RMB).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: There is no recurring annual UBO confirmation form in the PRC. Instead, the Beneficial Owner Information Registration Measures (effective 1 September 2024) impose an initial filing requirement for existing companies and a mandatory 30-day reporting window for any change of beneficial owner, including shareholding transfers or changes in ultimate control. Any transfer of registered shares must be recorded in the Company Shareholder Register, and the shareholding change must be reported to the SAMR through the local market regulator within 30 days of the transfer. The annual Enterprise Information Disclosure, while not a UBO form, requires the company to confirm its current equity investors, registered capital, controllers, and corporate operational information every year by 30 June.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 to USD 1,500 per year for a commercial registered operating address plus licensed corporate agent or filing support service; premium multi-entity addresses range from USD 1,500 to USD 3,000
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,200 to USD 3,500 for a typical single-entity WFOE with simple equity and local-only transactions; USD 5,000 to USD 12,000 when the WFOE is part of a multinational consolidation with intercompany financing, transfer pricing documentation, and complex related-party balances

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: A WFOE manufacturing LiFePO4 battery packs may access the High-and-New Technology Enterprise preferential 15% CIT rate; eligible R&D expenses enjoy a 100% additional deduction, producing a total 200% deduction on qualified R&D outlay until at least 31 December 2027; small low-profit enterprises pay an effective 5% rate on up to RMB 3 million taxable income; and qualified automation/manufacturing equipment may be eligible for accelerated depreciation. All such incentives require China-based substance, written approval or filing records, and satisfaction of the relevant industry and activity conditions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form A100000, the PRC Corporate Income Tax Annual Return (Class A), together with supporting adjustment schedules, filed through the State Taxation Administration e-Tax electronic filing portal. The WFOE, as a Chinese tax-resident enterprise, files this return for its worldwide income. Non-resident dividend, interest and royalty withholding is separately reported on the non-resident enterprise withholding income tax return (Form class F) in the same portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual settlement of the final CIT liability, with mandatory quarterly provisional CIT payments. The quarterly prepayment returns are filed within 15 days after each calendar quarter end and the annual final return is filed after the end of the calendar tax year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The PRC tax year is the calendar year. Quarterly provisional returns are due by 15 April, 15 July and 15 October for the first three quarters; the fourth quarter prepayment may be combined with the annual return. The annual CIT return and final tax payment are due on or before 31 May of the year following the tax year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross turnover from the sale of assembled LiFePO4 battery packs, battery modules, energy storage systems, inverters/BMS units, spare parts and related installation or maintenance services, stated net of Chinese VAT output tax and before any profit tax adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE is a PRC resident enterprise and must report all worldwide income. Export sales invoiced in foreign currency are converted at the central parity rate on the invoice or customs declaration date and must be reconciled to customs data. Sales made to a foreign parent or offshore affiliate must be stated at arm's length; if the export price is artificially depressed, the tax administration will impose an upward transfer pricing adjustment under EIT Law Article 41.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Costs of principal raw materials and components, including imported LiFePO4 cells, BMS, connectors, enclosure and thermal management materials, plus direct labor, manufacturing overhead, depreciation, tooling and accruals for warranty.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Imported materials from overseas related parties must be booked using the transfer price actually paid, but that price must conform to the arm's length standard. Customs values, intercompany purchase agreements and TP policy documentation should be identical. Any inflated inbound transfer price that shifts profit offshore will be adjusted downward and the WFOE will face an added tax assessment and penalty risk.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible indirect taxes and surcharges: urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharge, local education surcharge, stamp duty, property tax, land-use tax and other taxes recognized as deductible under PRC rules. VAT itself is not an expense and is excluded.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Withholding taxes imposed on payments to non-resident shareholders or service providers are not deductible as taxes and surcharges on the WFOE's own return. Where the WFOE withholds Chinese tax on royalties, interest or dividends payable to a foreign beneficiary, the withheld amount is a liability of the non-resident, not an expense of the WFOE.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selling expenses, general and administrative expenses, finance expenses and separately identified R&D expenses before the additional deduction. Employee compensation, utilities, logistics, bank charges, foreign exchange losses, professional fees and manufacturing administration are included.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intra-group management and service charges paid to foreign affiliates are deductible only when the services were actually rendered, the WFOE demonstrably received a benefit, and the charge is at arm's length. Royalties paid to a foreign IP owner must be supported by a license agreement, value-chain contribution analysis, and TP documentation. Intercompany interest is limited by the 3:1 debt-to-equity thin-capitalization rule and arm's length rate requirements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating profit from Boxes 1 through 4, adjusted for non-operating income such as government grants, asset disposal gains, insurance compensation, and non-operating expenses such as donations, fines and inventory written-down.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Tax-exempt government grants for research or regional investment are included in accounting profit but removed later in the reconciliation. Fines and administrative penalties paid to Chinese authorities are non-deductible additions. Dividends received from other PRC-resident enterprises may be tax-exempt; foreign-source dividends are included and may generate a foreign tax credit using the separate schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 - Total accounting profit before income tax
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Sum of operating profit, non-operating income and less non-operating expenses, equal to profit before tax per the PRC GAAP audited financial statements of the WFOE.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This is the starting point of the tax reconciliation. A loss reported here is carried forward for up to five years after the year in which it was incurred and is usable only against taxable income. If the WFOE is systematically loss-making while the offshore group records high profits from sales of Chinese battery packs, the tax authorities will treat the loss as a red flag and may recharacterize the pricing model.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7 - Tax reconciliation additions and deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All compliance adjustments to move accounting profit to taxable income: non-deductible expenses, fines, excess entertainment and advertising costs, inventory impairment, thin-capitalization interest, unapproved asset depreciation, loss offset, tax-exempt income, R&D super deduction, and similar schedule adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident-related additions are common: excessive royalties, management fees, interest and related-party service charges that fail the benefit test or arm's length test are added back. The approved 100% R&D super deduction is claimed separately for battery cell chemistry, LFP pack assembly, safety and thermal management research. All adjustments must be supported by contemporaneous documentation and reconciliation to the annual filing package.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final PRC taxable income, calculated as total accounting profit, plus additions, minus reductions/deductions, less loss carryover. Negative taxable income is zero for the year and carried forward subject to the five-year rule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a foreign-owned WFOE, the tax authority will compare taxable income with gross profit at arm's length for the battery manufacturing industry. A sudden reduction of taxable income through an intra-group trademark or technology fee after the company becomes profitable will normally trigger special tax auditing, transfer pricing inspection and anti-abuse recharacterization.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 9 - Computed tax, credits and net tax payable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Apply the statutory tax rate to taxable income, subtract the reduced HNTE rate or small-profit rate, deduct tax credits such as foreign tax credit and venture investment credit, and credit the quarterly provisional payments already made, resulting in the final tax payable or refund.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Dividend withholding tax payable to foreign shareholders is not included on this line and cannot be credited against the WFOE's own CIT. That withholding is a shareholder-level tax collected by the WFOE under the non-resident withholding regime. Any foreign tax credit added here must relate only to the WFOE's own foreign-source income taxed abroad, not to taxes paid by its foreign parent or shareholders.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual return attracts a penalty of RMB 2,000 under Tax Collection and Administration Law Article 62, increased to RMB 2,000-10,000 for serious non-filing. Underpaid tax bears a daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% from the due date. Under-reported income, false declarations, or transfer pricing mispricing can be reassessed and fined at 50%-500% of the underpainted tax under Article 63. A WFOE that files fraudulent export declarations or fake VAT invoices may expose the company and directors to criminal tax fraud liability under Criminal Law Articles 201, 204 and 205; aggravated VAT export rebate fraud can lead to imprisonment exceeding ten years or life imprisonment. The tax administration also publicizes serious dishonest taxpayers, which triggers travel bans, restricted high-consumption measures, blacklist entry, and denial of exit or deregistration until the liabilities are settled.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory withholding tax on dividends paid by the Chinese WFOE to a non-resident enterprise shareholder, unless a Double Tax Treaty or tax arrangement reduces that rate for a qualified beneficial owner.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Before a dividend is remitted, the WFOE, as withholding agent, must apply the reduced DTA rate through the State Taxation Administration e-Tax portal using the non-resident enterprise income tax withholding form. The supporting package must include: (i) a current-year Tax Residency Certificate issued by the tax authority of the recipient jurisdiction; (ii) a beneficial ownership declaration showing that the recipient is not a conduit, has the right to and control over the dividends, and has substance (employees, premises, economic activity and decision-making) in its residence state; (iii) the complete shareholding register demonstrating, for example, at least 25 percent ownership where a 5 percent treaty dividend rate is claimed; (iv) the applicable treaty article and working re: the DTA benefit; and (v) audited financial statements or board resolutions evidencing actual receipt/control of the dividend. If the documentation is incomplete or the beneficial owner test is not satisfied, the WFOE must withhold the statutory 10% and the shareholder may seek a refund only through an administrative review or treaty mutual agreement procedure.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: China's statutory source-WHT rate is 10% on interest and royalties paid by a PRC resident to a non-resident enterprise without a permanent establishment in China. Treaty and tax-arrangement rates commonly provide for interest of 5%-10% and royalties of 5%-10% depending on the counterparty jurisdiction, but the recipient must prove beneficial ownership of the interest or intangible and satisfy the anti-conduit rule. Intercompany interest is additionally subject to the 3:1 debt-to-equity thin-capitalization limitation and the earnings-stripping/arm's length interest scrutiny in the transfer pricing framework.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Under State Taxation Administration Announcement No. 42 (2016), contemporaneous Local File preparation is mandatory when annual related-party tangible asset transfers exceed RMB 200 million, intangible asset transfers exceed RMB
